title: GTA 6 Rumored Lucia Actress Dodges Fan Comments in Viral Stream
description: Manni L. Perez, the rumored actress for Lucia in GTA 6, went viral after skillfully avoiding a wave of fan comments during a recent livestream.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 6 Rumored Lucia Actress Goes Viral

The anticipation surrounding Rockstar Games' upcoming Grand Theft Auto VI continues to reach new heights, pulling anyone remotely associated with the project into the global spotlight. Recently, according to a report by IGN Games, Manni L. Perez—the actress long rumored to portray protagonist Lucia in GTA 6—has gone viral after artfully dodging a massive swarm of comments from eager fans during a livestream.

## Navigating the Spotlight

Ever since the initial reveal trailer for GTA 6 dropped, the gaming community has been relentlessly searching for details, leading many to speculate that Perez is the talent behind Lucia (please note: this remains an unconfirmed rumor, as Rockstar Games has not officially announced the full voice cast). During her recent online broadcast, fans flooded the chat with questions and references to the highly anticipated title. Faced with the overwhelming wave of GTA-related commentary, Perez handled the situation adeptly, steering clear of the speculation while keeping the stream moving forward. The clip quickly captured the attention of the internet, spreading rapidly across social media platforms.

## Editor's Take

This amusing viral moment highlights just how passionate and hungry the GTA community is for any scrap of information regarding GTA 6. While the speculation is harmless fun for many, it also serves as a reminder to respect performers' boundaries as we await official announcements from Rockstar Games.

## Looking Ahead

As development on GTA 6 continues, the mystery surrounding the cast will eventually be put to rest. Until then, the community's endless fascination proves that the hype train shows no signs of slowing down.
